data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to provide SMS code autofill support.
data.what_it_does: Provides SMS verification code autofill support for Android using the SMSRetriever API. Includes pin input widgets and mixins for custom listening behavior.
use_when: You need SMS code verification autofill on Android.
You want PIN input fields that automatically fill when an SMS is received.
avoid_when: You are developing for non-mobile platforms.
You need full SMS reading permissions (this plugin uses SMSRetriever which does not require read SMS permissions).
strengths: No permission to read SMS messages is required.
Provides pre-built widgets like PinFieldAutoFill and TextFieldPinAutoFill.
weaknesses: Requires specific SMS formatting rules on the backend (ending with an 11-character hash string).
Primarily targets Android since iOS handles SMS autofill natively.
data.setup_notes: Requires the incoming SMS message to follow the SMSRetriever API format, including the 11-character app signature hash.
